_comment: The campfire's aura: heals every wounded allied entity within 1.5 units for 12% of their own max HP every 60 ticks, uncapped target count, and casts light out to 7.0 units. Costs nothing since a campfire cannot pay a resource cost. Healing by percent of max HP means higher-level characters restore at the same rate. All values placeholder.
name: CampfireAura
